svg.title: Single-Agent vs Multi-Agent healthcare AI pipeline comparison
svg.desc: Flow diagram comparing three variants: Single-Agent Constrained, Single-Agent Unconstrained, and Multi-Agent (Planner → Reasoner → Verifier), all fed with clinical case input and scored by LLM-as-Judge.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What clinical cases were used as input?')
sendPrompt('How does the constrained single-agent work?')
sendPrompt('What does the single-agent system prompt include?')
sendPrompt('What was the single-agent constrained overall score?')
sendPrompt('What is in the unconstrained single-agent 7-step prompt?')
sendPrompt('What was the unconstrained single-agent score?')
sendPrompt('What does the multi-agent header mean?')
sendPrompt('What does the Planner agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Reasoner agent do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Verifier agent do?')
sendPrompt('What was the multi-agent overall score?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM-as-Judge evaluation work?')
sendPrompt('What does the +1.30 quality gain mean?')
sendPrompt('What is the latency tradeoff of multi-agent?')
sendPrompt('Why is the safety awareness gap the most important finding?')
g.text: warfarin · thiamine · anti-D · DOAC — all missed by SA
